title: Setting and Moving the Closing Date on a Home Purchase Agreement
content:
Closing coordination applies the following calendar rules to every Home Purchase Agreement. The day counts and fees are the collection's figures.

**Closing date notice.** The scheduled closing date must be at least the collection's minimum closing date notice (calendar days) after the date of the closing date notice.

**Orientation.** The new home orientation is held the collection's orientation days before the scheduled closing date.

**Buyer extensions.** A buyer may move the scheduled closing date later up to the collection's maximum number of buyer closing extensions. Each extension carries the collection's closing extension fee, booked as a closing extension fee charge. The closing schedule reads three figures of the agreement's own collection: its closing extension fee, its per diem and its per diem grace days.

The former clause under which each extension adds the collection's closing extension days to the current scheduled closing date is **no longer in force**; the new closing date of a buyer extension is set under the current basis that superseded it.

**Status of the agreement.** A closing extension is written only on an agreement whose status is closing scheduled. The status is read from the agreement record.

**Builder delay.** A move of the closing date caused by a builder delay is written as a closing extension without fee, does not use one of the buyer's extensions and accrues no per diem.

## Reading the rules together (hypothetical agreement)

| Agreement status | Kind of move | Fee | Counts toward the buyer's extensions |
|---|---|---|---|
| Closing scheduled | Buyer-requested extension, within the maximum | Closing extension fee charged | Yes |
| Closing scheduled | Move caused by a builder delay | None | No |
| Under construction or ratified | Any closing extension | — | A closing extension is not written |

*Notice illustration (hypothetical).* In a collection with a 30-day minimum notice, a closing date notice dated 2 May allows a scheduled closing date of 1 June or later (2 May plus 30 calendar days is 1 June); 31 May would be too early. In a collection with a 7-day orientation figure, a 1 June closing has its orientation on 25 May.

superseded_clauses: each extension adds closing_extension_days calendar days to the current scheduled closing date
